source_context.human_quote: we need to add this to the workspace - we need an interactive map for all of our projects and upcoming prospects. of our entire market - that we can put prospects, active clients, and projects in process in so that it helps us to have a visual aid of where things are going on. and it will help us with planning to. we have to coordinate travel pretty efficiently and combine multiple site visits in a single day trip. note that dell and i are both very visual. we both benefit from high quality visual data and smart presentation plus interactive components
source_context.interpretation: This is a Workspace operating requirement and council amendment, not permission to construct, migrate, deploy, select a paid vendor, or change canonical doctrine before approval.

recommendation: Approve a visual-first Market Map and Day-Trip Planner as a first-class CARR Workspace capability. It shows the entire authorized market across prospects, active clients, projects in process, and active project locations; keeps map and list synchronized; sends exact users back to the owning canonical record; and composes efficient multi-stop site-visit proposals into the governed Tour workflow. The map remains a tenant-scoped read projection and planning surface, never a record writer or source of truth.
why_now: Spatial context is a missing business-state dimension in the current Workspace roadmap.
Joe and Dell are both strongly visual, making information design and interaction core adoption constraints rather than polish.

The existing Tour Mode already defines locked appointments, ordered routes, offline packs, and post-tour review, so the market map should feed that governed lifecycle instead of creating a second travel system.
Phase 0 is the inexpensive moment to separate canonical business records, location meaning, geocoding projections, and route proposals before data volume and vendor coupling make correction costly.

proposed_product_placement.workspace_role: run and understand the business spatially
proposed_product_placement.desktop_web: first-class route available through More and eligible for primary navigation after measured adoption
proposed_product_placement.command_center: small spatial summary or needs-attention deep link only; no duplicate full map
proposed_product_placement.lead_board_and_deal_room: own the canonical prospect, client, and project records opened from markers or list rows
proposed_product_placement.tour_mode: owns confirmed trip itinerary, offline execution, note/photo capture, sync, and post-tour review

domain_model_correction.rule: Entity class and location meaning are separate dimensions.
domain_model_correction.cardinality: One prospect, client, or project may contribute zero, one, or many independently sourced map items. A client may show a current practice and target market; an in-process project may show a search area and several candidate properties.
domain_model_correction.current_schema_fact: Building and prospect-pool records have postal address fields but no canonical latitude/longitude today.
domain_model_correction.unlocated_semantics: Every view reports located and unlocated counts and exposes an explicit verification queue. A missing location remains in the equivalent list and is never silently omitted or assigned a plausible coordinate.

visual_adoption_contract.default: whole-market extent, map/list split, visible legend, separate record/location counts, current/stale/Unknown/unlocated summary, filters, selected-record panel, and day-trip builder
visual_adoption_contract.non_color_coding: Category, lifecycle, owner, freshness, precision, and trip selection use text, shape/icon, or pattern in addition to color.
interaction: separate Today/7/30 planning horizon and freshness/Changed Since filters
visual_adoption_contract.parity: Map and list carry the same stable location ID, label, category, status, owner, freshness, precision, selection, and deep link; focus, filter, and selection synchronize both ways.
visual_adoption_contract.accessibility: Keyboard and screen-reader users receive the complete equivalent list, map summary, filter state, route order, exclusions, and warnings; 200 percent zoom, 44-pixel targets, reduced motion, and phone/tablet/desktop layouts remain required.
visual_adoption_contract.cutover_test: Can Joe or Dell understand the market and assemble this routine trip without opening Claude Code or Codex? Adoption is not successful until each does so uncoached.

travel_planning_contract.goal: Combine compatible visits into feasible single-day trips while minimizing travel and schedule risk.
output: skipped and infeasible candidates with reasons
route provider, observed time, and declared model inputs
travel_planning_contract.human_gate: The optimization result is a proposal. Joe or Dell confirms the exact version before it enters Tour Mode; calendar, navigation, appointment, or message side effects require separate governed actions.
travel_planning_contract.truth_rule: Do not claim mathematical optimality, Live traffic, or feasibility without fresh provider and schedule evidence. A material input change invalidates prior confirmation.

provider_evidence.required_gate: Fresh official pricing and terms review for selected SKUs; approved billing and usage caps; canonical vendor-independent CARR address/area inputs; isolated provider projections; expiry/purge/refresh proof; attribution; compatible map; provider-exit rehearsal.

non_negotiable_boundaries: No map, marker drag, route optimizer, vendor result, browser field, URL, Doc response, or model output becomes canonical business truth.
Tenant and business workspace are server-derived on every record, map item, query, route candidate, cache, export, vendor call, and audit event.
Exact location and identity follow role, workspace, redaction, and minimum-necessary precision; privacy-safe denial leaks neither existence nor approximation.
Unlocated, stale, partial, or Unknown inputs remain explicit and never enter false totals or route feasibility.
Aggregates with any stale, Unknown, unlocated, or missing child render Mixed/Partial with exact component counts.
Clusters are authorized before computation and disclose record versus location counts, co-location, and multi-location membership only through the equivalent accessible list.
Planning horizon never substitutes for freshness or Changed Since.
The whole-market view is absent in sterile/client-facing mode; an explicit client-scoped tour exposes only its authorized pins.
No public map URLs expose record IDs, exact coordinates, visit schedules, client identity, or travel patterns.
Phase 0 uses synthetic data and read-only transport; it makes no live accuracy, accessibility, privacy, routing-quality, cost, or adoption claim.

council_decisions_requested.question: Approve the Market Map and Day-Trip Planner as a first-class Workspace requirement feeding Tour Mode?
Approve entity/location-role separation, multi-location records, explicit unlocated counts, and vendor-isolated geocode projections as locked Phase 0 rails?
Retain Google as the preferred measured routing direction while keeping final map/provider choice gated by terms, portability, cost, visual quality, and acceptance evidence?
Require Joe and Dell to pass the same uncoached visual and trip-planning adoption journey before the feature counts as adopted?

acceptance_summary: Whole authorized market includes prospects, active clients, projects in process, and active project locations with explicit unlocated counts.
Map/list parity is exact and accessible across desktop, tablet, and phone.
Exact source, version, freshness, location precision, redaction, and owning-record link are visible.
Cross-tenant, cross-workspace, redacted-field, export, cache, Doc, background, and vendor-egress denial fixtures pass.
Trip proposals preserve locked appointments, explain exclusions and Unknowns, compare alternatives, and require confirmation before Tour handoff.
Joe and Dell each complete the visual routine uncoached without a heavy AI session.
Provider terms, cache retention, attribution, portability, measured usage, cost caps, and degraded operation are freshly proven.
phase_boundary: Council recommendation and Joe approval are required before production construction. This proposal does not expand the October Mature Foundation commitment or alter website-first delivery.
